name: source-control
description: Source Control for Claude Code: Git status above the chat box, a panel with changes, commit, a history graph, branches and worktrees, plus fetch, pull, push and sync in one click, and how far the branch is behind its base branch with one-click update from it. English and German.

fetchIntervalMinutes.title: Fetch interval (minutes)
fetchIntervalMinutes.description: How often `git fetch` runs in the background, so ↓ counts are right. 0 turns it off.

pollSeconds.title: Status poll (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: How often the local Git status is read (no network). Claude’s commands and your actions refresh at once anyway.

staleAfterHours.title: Stale after (hours)
staleAfterHours.description: When the last fetch counts as old and is marked yellow.

language.title: Language
language.description: `auto` follows Claude Code’s language; `en` or `de` sets it.

baseBranch.title: Base branch
baseBranch.description: The branch to compare with and update from, e.g. `main` or `upstream/develop`. Empty: the remote’s default branch, `upstream` before `origin`.

baseUpdateMode.title: Update from base
baseUpdateMode.description: `merge` merges the base branch into the current branch; `rebase` rebases the current branch onto it.

tellClaude.title: Tell Claude
tellClaude.description: After a git action from the band or the panel (pull, push, merge, commit, …), add a short note that Claude reads with the next message. It starts no turn.
